archetype: Archetype 5 (Jewel & Luxury) mixed with Archetype 2 (Performance Pro)

buttons.primary: bg-[#D4AF37] text-black font-semibold rounded-full py-4 px-6 active:opacity-80 flex-row items-center justify-center
buttons.secondary: bg-transparent border border-[#D4AF37] text-[#D4AF37] rounded-full py-4 px-6 active:bg-[#D4AF37]/10 flex-row items-center justify-center

cards.default: bg-[#121212] rounded-2xl border border-zinc-800 p-5 shadow-lg

inputs.default: bg-[#0A0A0A] border border-zinc-800 text-white rounded-xl px-4 py-4 focus:border-[#D4AF37] text-base

auth.notes: Use a full-screen luxury abstract background with a heavy dark overlay to ensure text readability. Inputs should be translucent.

onboarding_quiz.layout: Step-based card selection with large hit areas.
onboarding_quiz.progress_bar: Gold fill over dark zinc track.
onboarding_quiz.cards: Selectable cards with gold border when selected (`border-[#D4AF37] bg-[#D4AF37]/10`). Unselected state is standard surface color.

dashboard.workout_card: Uses a background image of an aesthetic dark gym with a gradient overlay. Large bold typography for the workout name. Card should span full width.
dashboard.water_tracker: Circular progress ring in light blue (#38BDF8) to contrast with gold, or matching gold if strictly monochrome. Include a glass icon.
dashboard.reminders: Vertical timeline layout with gold dots indicating active reminders (Wake, Workout, Meal, Sleep).

ai_coach.user_bubble: bg-[#D4AF37] text-black rounded-2xl rounded-tr-sm px-4 py-3 ml-10
ai_coach.ai_bubble: bg-[#121212] border border-zinc-800 text-white rounded-2xl rounded-tl-sm px-4 py-3 mr-10

shop.card: bg-[#121212] rounded-2xl overflow-hidden. Image at top with dark background, text below.

image_urls.description: Luxurious abstract gold/black waves for auth/login screens.
Sleek industrial gym background for the 'Today's Workout' card.
Elegant 3D gold geometric sphere for the AI bot avatar.
Gym floor with gloves (use for general fitness gear if needed).

accessibility_and_interactions.test_ids: MANDATORY. Add `data-testid` to all interactive elements, inputs, and key text nodes (e.g. `data-testid='login-button'`).
accessibility_and_interactions.contrast: Ensure text over images uses a dark gradient overlay. Minimum `#000000` at 60% opacity.
accessibility_and_interactions.touch_targets: Minimum 48x48px for all pressables to ensure mobile accessibility.

instructions_to_main_agent: This is a React Native Expo project. Use NativeWind classes suitable for mobile.
Do not use `hover:` classes. Use `active:` for press states.
For the bottom tab navigation, use a dark bar `#0A0A0A` with gold `#D4AF37` for the active tab icon.
Follow the luxury dark theme strictly. No bright white backgrounds anywhere. The app should feel like an exclusive VIP fitness club.
Build the dashboard rings using react-native-svg or expo-progress.
